## Supplementary Fig 3: Propensity Matching Quality
Love plot shows standardized mean differences (SMD) of baseline covariates before (unmatched) and after (matched) propensity score matching between patients treated with anakinra prophylaxis on study and real-world control patients treated without anakinra prophylaxis.

```{r suppfig1}
# Define severe ICAHT
main_df <- main_df %>%
  mutate(
    icaht34=case_when(
      is.na(max_icaht)~NA,
      as.numeric(max_icaht)>=3~TRUE,
      .default = FALSE
    )
  )

# Include only MSK patients for matching analysis
df_nomissing <- main_df  %>% filter(grepl("msk", record_id)) 

# Matching variables include age, KPS stratified as >= 90 vs < 90, costimulatory domain, lymphoma subtype (FL, LBCL, MCL), disease response at infusion, and elevated LDH. 
set.seed(1)
match_obj <- matchit(cohort_2lvl ~ age + kps_2lvl + costim + dx_heme + ds_res_infusion + bin_preld_ldh, 
                     data = df_nomissing,
                     method = "optimal",
                     distance = "logit", 
                     ratio=1
                     )


matched_data <- match.data(match_obj)
cohort1 <- (matched_data %>% filter(akra_cohort=="cohort 1"))$subclass
cohort2 <- (matched_data %>% filter(akra_cohort=="cohort 2"))$subclass

m1 <- matched_data %>%
  mutate(akra_cohort=case_when(
    subclass %in% cohort1 & akra_cohort=="cohort 1"~"cohort1",
    subclass %in% cohort1 & akra_cohort=="no anakinra"~"cohort1 control",
    subclass %in% cohort2 & akra_cohort=="cohort 2"~"cohort2",
    subclass %in% cohort2 & akra_cohort=="no anakinra"~"cohort2 control"
  )) %>%
  mutate(akra_cohort=factor(akra_cohort, levels=c("cohort1 control","cohort1", "cohort2 control", "cohort2")))

# Love plot shows 
sp1 <- love.plot(match_obj,
  stats = "mean.diffs",       
  abs = T,                 
  var.order = "unadjusted",   
  threshold = 0.1,
  colors = c("red", "blue"),  # unadjusted vs adjusted
  shapes = c(17, 16)
)
# SMD for distance = 0.12
(sp1@data %>% filter(Sample=="Adjusted") %>% filter(var=="distance"))$stat

print(sp1)
ggsave(here('figures/round3', 'suppfig3.pdf'), plot = sp1)
```

## Figure S1 - Blood plasma specimen collection across cohorts for cytokine profiling.

```{r fig1d, fig.width=10, fig.height=7, dpi=150}
figs1 <- c1_luminex %>% filter(source=='plasma') %>% 
  mutate(day_rel_car=ifelse(day_rel_car < 0, 'Screen', as.character(day_rel_car))) %>% 
  mutate(cohort="cohort 1") %>%
  select(record_id, cohort, day_rel_car) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    c2_luminex %>% 
      filter(cytokine=='egf') %>% # EGF was measured successfully in every luminex assay run for cohort 2
      filter(source=='plasma') %>% 
      filter(day_rel_car >= -21 & day_rel_car < 45) %>% 
      mutate(day_rel_car=ifelse(day_rel_car < 0, 'Screen', as.character(day_rel_car))) %>% 
      mutate(cohort="cohort 2") %>% select(record_id, cohort, day_rel_car),
    match_olink %>% select(record_id, day_rel_car) %>%
      filter(day_rel_car >= -21 & day_rel_car < 45) %>% 
      mutate(day_rel_car=ifelse(day_rel_car < 0, 'Screen', as.character(day_rel_car))) %>% 
      left_join(df_nomissing %>% select(record_id, cohort=akra_cohort)) 
  ) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(day_rel_car=factor(day_rel_car, levels=c('Screen', as.character(0:45)))) %>% 
  group_by(cohort, day_rel_car) %>% reframe(freq=n()) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=day_rel_car, y=freq, fill=cohort)) +
  xlab('') + ylab('')+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("cohort 1" = "#1F5AA6", "cohort 2" = "#087F8C", "no anakinra" = 'darkred'))+
  theme_classic() + 
  facet_grid(cohort~.) + 
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial", size=20),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=0),
        legend.position='none') + 
  geom_bar(stat='identity', color='black', alpha=0.7)

print(figs1)
ggsave(here('figures/round3', 'figs1.pdf'), plot = figs1, width = 10, height=7)

```

## Table 1 Stratified by Cohort
```{r Table 1}
tbl1 <- main_df %>%
  select(!akra_cohort) %>% 
  left_join(m1 %>% select(record_id, akra_cohort)) %>% 
  mutate(akra_cohort=ifelse(is.na(akra_cohort), "Non-matched", as.character(akra_cohort))) %>%
  mutate(akra_cohort=ifelse(grepl('hmh', record_id), "cohort2", as.character(akra_cohort))) %>%
  mutate(akra_cohort=factor(akra_cohort, levels=c("cohort1 control","cohort1", "cohort2 control", "cohort2", 'Non-matched'))) %>% 
  transmute(
    Age = age,
    `Female Sex` = case_when(
      is.na(sex)~NA,
      sex=='female'~1,
      .default=0
    ),
    
    Race = race,
    Ethnicity=ethnicity,
    
    `Karnofsky Performance Status < 90` = 
      case_when(
      is.na(kps_2lvl)~NA,
      kps_2lvl=='<90'~1,
      .default=0
    ),
    `BMI` = as.numeric(trimws(bmi)),
    `Diagnosis` = 
      case_when(
        dx_heme=="large b-cell lymphoma" & lbcl_subtype=="dlbcl nos"~"Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma NOS",
        dx_heme=="large b-cell lymphoma" & lbcl_subtype=="high-grade b-cell ly."~"High-Grade B-cell Lymphoma",
        dx_heme=="large b-cell lymphoma" & lbcl_subtype=="other lbcl"~"Other LBCL",
        dx_heme=="mantle cell lymphoma"~"Mantle Cell Lymphoma",
        dx_heme=="follicular lymphoma"~"Follicular Lymphoma"
      ),
    `Transformed Disease` = 
      case_when(
        lbcl_trans_dr=="de-novo lbcl"~ "De-novo LBCL",
        lbcl_trans_dr=="transformed lbcl"~ "Transformed LBCL",
        lbcl_trans_dr=="Not applicable"~ "Not LBCL"
      ),
    `Bulky (>10cm) Disease at Apheresis` = bulky10cm_aph,
    `History of CNS Disease` = cns_hx,
    `Active CNS Disease at Infusion` = active_cns,
    `Number of Treatment Lines before CAR-T` = num_lines_precar,
    `Prior AutoSCT` = auto_hx,
    `Refractory to Treatment Line before Apheresis` = ref_aph,
    `Primary Refractory Disease` = 
      case_when(
      is.na(primary_ref)~NA,
      primary_ref=='yes'~1,
      .default=0
    ),
    `Underwent Bridging Therapy` = bridge,
    `IPI at Apheresis` = case_when(
      ipi_aph %in% c('0', '1') ~ 'Low 0-1',
      ipi_aph %in% c('2', '3') ~ 'Intermediate 2-3',
      ipi_aph %in% c('4', '5') ~ 'High 4-5'
      ),
     SPD = as.numeric(spd),
    `Pre-LD Elevated LDH` = bin_preld_ldh,
    `Disease Status at Infusion` = case_when(
      ds_res_infusion %in% c("cr") ~ "CR",
      ds_res_infusion %in% c("pr") ~ "PR",
      ds_res_infusion %in% c("sd","pod") ~ "SD/POD",
      ds_res_infusion %in% c("unevaluable") ~ "Unevaluable"
      ),
    `Pre-infusion CRP` = d0_crp_raw,
    `CAR-T Product` = str_to_sentence(car_t_product),
     akra_cohort = factor(case_when(
      akra_cohort == 'cohort1' ~ 'Cohort 1',
      akra_cohort == 'cohort1 control' ~ 'Cohort 1\nControl',
      akra_cohort == 'cohort2' ~ 'Cohort 2',
      akra_cohort == 'cohort2 control' ~ 'Cohort 2\nControl',
      akra_cohort == 'Non-matched' ~ 'Unmatched'
    ), levels = c(
      'Cohort 1',
      'Cohort 1\nControl',
      'Cohort 2',
      'Cohort 2\nControl',
      'Unmatched'
    )
    )
  ) %>% 
  tbl_summary(by="akra_cohort")

tbl1

tbl1 %>%
  as_flex_table() %>%
  flextable::save_as_docx(path = here("figures/round3", "table1.docx"))
```

# Toxicity Analysis

## Figure 2A - Rates of immuno- and hematotoxicity

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=5, dpi=150}
common_clean <- main_df %>%
  select(!akra_cohort) %>% 
  left_join(m1 %>% select(record_id, subclass, akra_cohort)) %>% 
  mutate(akra_cohort=ifelse(grepl('hmh', record_id), "cohort2", as.character(akra_cohort))) %>%
  transmute(
    record_id,
    `ICANS > 2` = case_when(
      is.na(icans34)~NA,
      icans34==T~1,
      .default=0
    ),
    `ICANS > 1` = case_when(
      is.na(icans24)~NA,
      icans24==T~1,
      .default=0
    ),
    `ICANS Duration (Days)` = as.numeric(dur_icans),
    `CRS > 2` = case_when(
      is.na(crs34)~NA,
      crs34==T~1,
      .default=0
    ),
    `CRS Duration (Days)` = as.numeric(dur_crs),
    `ICU Admission` = case_when(
      is.na(tox_icu)~NA,
      tox_icu=='yes'~1,
      .default=0
    ),
    `Blood Stream Infection` = case_when(
      is.na(tox_bsi)~NA,
      tox_bsi=='yes'~1,
      .default=0
    ),
    `CR by 1 Year` = case_when(
      is.na(everCR_365)~NA,
      everCR_365==T~1,
      .default=0
    ),
    `ICAHT > 2` = icaht34,
    `Treated with Tocilizumab` = case_when(
      is.na(toci_trt)~NA,
      toci_trt=='yes'~1,
      .default=0
    ),
    `Treated with Steroids` = case_when(
      is.na(steroids_trt)~NA,
      steroids_trt=='yes'~1,
      .default=0
    ),
    maxcrs,
    maxicans,
    max_icaht,
    tt_pfs_m,
    ev_pfs,
    tt_os_m,
    ev_os,
    ev_rel,
    subclass,
    akra_cohort,
    cohort_2lvl
  )

fig2a <- common_clean %>% 
  filter(akra_cohort %in% c('cohort1', "cohort2")) %>% 
  select(record_id,maxcrs, maxicans, max_icaht, akra_cohort) %>% 
  mutate_all(factor) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(record_id, akra_cohort), names_to = 'outcomes', values_to = 'grade') %>%
  group_by(akra_cohort, outcomes, grade) %>% reframe(freq=n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(outcomes=factor(outcomes, levels=c("maxicans", 'maxcrs', 'max_icaht'))) %>%
  mutate(grade = factor(grade, levels=c(NA, '5', '4', '3', '2', '1', '0'))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=interaction(akra_cohort, outcomes), y=freq, fill=grade)) + 
  xlab('') + ylab('') + 
  geom_col() + 
  theme_classic() +
  geom_text(aes(label=freq), size=6, hjust=0.5, vjust=3, position='stack') + 
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
        axis.title = element_text(size=18),
        axis.text = element_text(size=16),
        legend.position='none') + 
  scale_fill_npg()

print(fig2a)
ggsave(here(figures_dir, "fig2a.pdf"), plot=fig2a, width = 14, height=5, dpi = 150)
```

## Table S2 Rates of each grade of CRS and ICANS and their associated 95% CI (Secondary endpoints)
```{r}
propci <- function(cohort, variable, outcome) {
  temp <- binom.test(x=sum((common_clean$akra_cohort==paste0("cohort", cohort) & common_clean[variable]==outcome), na.rm=T), n=sum(common_clean$akra_cohort==paste0("cohort", cohort), na.rm=T), conf.level = 0.95)
  paste0("Cohort ", cohort, ", ", variable, "=", outcome, ": ", round(temp$estimate, 2), " 95% CI (", round(temp$conf.int[1], 2), " - ", round(temp$conf.int[2], 2), ")")
}

secondary_otcm <- as.data.frame(c(
  propci(1, 'CRS > 2', 1),
propci(2, 'CRS > 2', 1),
propci(1, 'maxcrs', 1),
propci(1, 'maxcrs', 2),
propci(1, 'maxcrs', 3),
propci(1, 'maxcrs', 4),
propci(2, 'maxcrs', 1),
propci(2, 'maxcrs', 2),
propci(2, 'maxcrs', 3),
propci(2, 'maxcrs', 4),

propci(1, 'maxicans', 1),
propci(1, 'maxicans', 2),
propci(1, 'maxicans', 3),
propci(1, 'maxicans', 4),
propci(2, 'maxicans', 1),
propci(2, 'maxicans', 2),
propci(2, 'maxicans', 3),
propci(2, 'maxicans', 4),

propci(1, 'Treated with Tocilizumab', 1),
propci(2, 'Treated with Tocilizumab', 1),

propci(1, 'Treated with Steroids', 1),
propci(2, 'Treated with Steroids', 1)
))

propci(1, 'ICANS > 2', 1)
propci(2, 'ICANS > 2', 1)

binom.test(x=sum((common_clean$akra_cohort %in% c("cohort1", "cohort2") & common_clean['ICANS > 2']==1), na.rm=T), n=sum(common_clean$akra_cohort %in% c("cohort1", "cohort2"), na.rm=T), conf.level = 0.95)


secondary_otcm
```

```{r}
# Get max grade infectious event per patient within 1 year of CAR-T cell infusion.
infect <- infectious_ctcae %>% 
  filter(is.na(day_rel_car) | day_rel_car >=0) %>% 
  filter(is.na(day_rel_car) | day_rel_car < 365.25) %>% 
  group_by(record_id) %>% slice(which.max(inf_ctcae)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(record_id, inf_ctcae) %>%
  mutate(`Infection > 1` = ifelse(inf_ctcae>=2, 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(`Infection > 2` = ifelse(inf_ctcae>=3, 1, 0)) 

common_clean <- common_clean %>% left_join(infect)
```

## Figure 2B 
```{r}
ccpsm <- common_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(akra_cohort)) %>% 
  filter(!grepl('hmh', record_id))

ccc2 <- common_clean %>%
  filter(akra_cohort %in% c('cohort1', 'cohort2'))

binary_outcomes <- c(
  'ICANS > 2',
  'ICANS > 1',
  'CRS > 2',
  'ICAHT > 2',
  'Treated with Tocilizumab', 
  'Treated with Steroids',
  'ICU Admission',
  'Blood Stream Infection',
  'Infection > 2'
)

continuous_outcomes <- c(
  'ICANS Duration (Days)',
  'CRS Duration (Days)'
)

surv_outcomes <- tribble(
  ~outcome, ~time,       ~event,
  "OS",     "tt_os_m",   "ev_os"
)

inc_outcomes <- tribble(
  ~outcome, ~time,       ~status, ~failcode,
  "NRM",    "tt_pfs_m",  "ev_rel", 2
)

cohort_var <- 'cohort_2lvl'
cohort_levels <- levels(factor(common_clean[[cohort_var]]))

binary_tbl <-
  map_dfr(binary_outcomes, function(outcome) {
    tibble(
      outcome = outcome,
      outcome_type = "Binary",
      psmcontrol_summary = fmt_binary(ccpsm, outcome, cohort_levels[1], cohort_var),
      psmtx_summary = fmt_binary(ccpsm, outcome, cohort_levels[2], cohort_var),
      
      effect = fmt_or(ccpsm, outcome, cohort_var),
      pval = fmt_or_pval(ccpsm, outcome, cohort_var)
      
    )
  })

cont_tbl <-
  map_dfr(continuous_outcomes, function(outcome) {
    tibble(
      outcome = outcome,
      outcome_type = "Continuous",
      psmcontrol_summary = fmt_continuous(ccpsm, outcome, cohort_levels[1], cohort_var),
            psmtx_summary = fmt_continuous(ccpsm, outcome, cohort_levels[2], cohort_var),
      
      effect = NA,
      pval = fmt_wilcox(data=ccpsm, outcome=outcome, cohort_levels=cohort_levels, cohort_var=cohort_var)
    )
  })

surv_tbl <-
  pmap_dfr(surv_outcomes, function(outcome, time, event) {
    tibble(
      outcome = outcome,
      outcome_type = "Time-to-event",
      psmcontrol_summary = fmt_median_surv(ccpsm, time, event, cohort_levels[1], cohort_var),
            psmtx_summary = fmt_median_surv(ccpsm, time, event, cohort_levels[2], cohort_var),
      
      effect = fmt_hr(ccpsm, time, event, cohort_var),
      pval = fmt_hr_pval(ccpsm, time, event, cohort_var)
    )
  })

inc_tbl <-
  pmap_dfr(inc_outcomes, function(outcome, time, status, failcode) {
    tibble(
      outcome = outcome,
      outcome_type = "Cumulative Incidence at 12 months",
      psmcontrol_summary = calc_cif_at_time(data = ccpsm,time=time,status=status,failcode=failcode,cohort_level=cohort_levels[1],cohort_var=cohort_var),
      psmtx_summary = calc_cif_at_time(data = ccpsm,time=time,status=status,failcode=failcode,cohort_level=cohort_levels[2],cohort_var=cohort_var),
      
      effect = fmt_cihr(data=ccpsm, time=time, event=status, cohort_var=cohort_var, etype=as.character(failcode)),
      pval = fmt_cihr_pval(data=ccpsm, time=time, event=status, cohort_var=cohort_var, etype=as.character(failcode))
    )
  })

library(gt)

final_outcome_tbl <-
  bind_rows(binary_tbl, surv_tbl, inc_tbl) %>% 
  gt(groupname_col = "outcome_type") |>
  cols_label(
    outcome = md("**Outcome**"),
    psmcontrol_summary = md(paste0("**", cohort_levels[1], "**")),
    psmtx_summary = md(paste0("**", cohort_levels[2], "**")),
    effect = md("**OR/HR (95% CI)**"),
    pval = md("**p value**")
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(psmcontrol_summary,psmtx_summary, effect)
  )

final_outcome_tbl

final_outcome_tbl %>%
  gtsave(here(figures_dir, "fig2b.docx"))

```

## Figure S9 - Anakinra dose escalations
```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=12, dpi=150}

# Row labels per study patient. 
m1_key <- m1 %>% filter(cohort_2lvl=="anakinra") %>% 
  transmute(trial_subclass=case_when(
    is.na(pinf_akra_dose_ind)~ paste0(trial_id, ", No dose escalation"),
    !is.na(pinf_akra_dose_ind)~ paste0(trial_id, ", ", pinf_akra_dose_ind)
    ), trial_id, subclass) %>%
  mutate(trial_id_no=as.numeric(gsub(".+ID(.+)", "\\1", trial_id))) %>% select(!trial_id)

roi_meta <- m1 %>% select(record_id, trial_id, akra_cohort, cohort_2lvl, subclass, weight, dose_ind=pinf_akra_dose_ind) %>% 
  mutate(dose_ind=ifelse(is.na(dose_ind), "No dose escalation", dose_ind)) %>%
  left_join(m1_key, by="subclass") %>% 
  arrange(akra_cohort, trial_id_no) %>%
  mutate(trial_subclass = factor(trial_subclass, levels = rev(unique(trial_subclass[order(akra_cohort)]))))

ad_akra <- data.frame(record_id=rep(roi_meta$record_id, each=29), day_rel_car=rep(seq(from=0, to=28, by=1), times=length(roi_meta$record_id))) %>%
  left_join(roi_meta)  %>%
  left_join(akra_doses) %>%
  mutate(numdose=ifelse(is.na(daily_dose), "0", daily_dose)) %>%
  mutate(numdose=as.character(numdose)) %>%
  mutate(cohort_2lvl=factor(cohort_2lvl, levels=c("anakinra", "control")))

ad_paired <- 
  ad_akra %>% 
  mutate(cohort_3lvl=case_when(
    grepl("control", akra_cohort)~"Control",
    .default=akra_cohort
  )) %>% 
  arrange(record_id, day_rel_car) %>%
  transmute(cohort_2lvl, akra_cohort, subclass, record_id, day_rel_car, numdose=as.numeric(numdose)) %>%
  mutate(akra_cohort=ifelse(grepl("1", akra_cohort), "cohort1", "cohort2")) %>% 
  group_by(cohort_2lvl, akra_cohort, subclass, record_id) %>% reframe(total_dose=(sum(numdose))) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(!record_id) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "cohort_2lvl", values_from = "total_dose") 

# Descriptive statistics for total anakinra dose expososure by cohort. 
akra_quant <- quantile( (ad_paired)$anakinra, probs=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75) ) 
akra_quant_c1 <- quantile( (ad_paired %>% filter(akra_cohort=="cohort1"))$anakinra, probs=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75) ) 
akra_quant_c2 <- quantile( (ad_paired %>% filter(akra_cohort=="cohort2"))$anakinra, probs=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75) ) 

# Each row represents a study patient (left) and their matched pair (right)
ad1 <- ad_akra %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=day_rel_car, y=trial_subclass, fill=numdose)) + 
  facet_wrap(.~cohort_2lvl) + 
  geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("0" = "white",
               "100" = "#c6dbef",
               "200" = "#6baed6",
               "300" = "#2171b5",
               "400" = "#08519c",
               "500" = "#08306b"),
    name = "Dose (mg)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.position="bottom") + 
  xlab("Days from CAR-T Infusion")

ad1

ggsave(here(figures_dir, "figs9.pdf"), plot=ad1, width = 8, height=12, dpi = 150)
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=12, dpi=150}
  left_join(il6_doses) %>%
  mutate(numdose=ifelse(is.na(numdose), "0", numdose)) %>%
  mutate(numdose=as.character(numdose)) %>%
  mutate(cohort_2lvl=factor(cohort_2lvl, levels=c("anakinra", "control")))

ad_paired <- 
  ad_toci %>% 
  mutate(cohort_3lvl=case_when(
    grepl("control", akra_cohort)~"Control",
    .default=akra_cohort
  )) %>% 
  arrange(record_id, day_rel_car) %>%
  transmute(cohort_2lvl, akra_cohort, subclass, record_id, day_rel_car, numdose=as.numeric(numdose)) %>%
  mutate(akra_cohort=ifelse(grepl("1", akra_cohort), "cohort1", "cohort2")) %>% 
  group_by(cohort_2lvl, akra_cohort, subclass, record_id) %>% reframe(total_dose=(sum(numdose))) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(!record_id) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "cohort_2lvl", values_from = "total_dose") 

# Comparison between study and PSM cohort for total number of IL6B doses administered
toci_ttest <- t.test(ad_paired$anakinra, ad_paired$control, paired = T)

# Descriptive statistics
toci_quant_akra <- quantile( (ad_paired)$anakinra, probs=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75) ) 
toci_quant_control <- quantile( (ad_paired)$control, probs=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75) ) 

toci_quant_c1 <- quantile( (ad_paired %>% filter(akra_cohort=="cohort1"))$anakinra, probs=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75) ) 
toci_quant_c2 <- quantile( (ad_paired %>% filter(akra_cohort=="cohort2"))$anakinra, probs=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75) ) 

# How many more doses of IL6B did each study patient receive over their matched pair
ad_paired1 <- ad_paired %>% mutate(ddiff = anakinra-control) %>%
  select(!c(anakinra, control)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "akra_cohort", values_from = "ddiff")
toci_quant_c1_diff <- quantile( (ad_paired1 %>% drop_na(cohort1))$cohort1, probs=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75) ) 
toci_quant_c2_diff <- quantile( (ad_paired1 %>% drop_na(cohort2))$cohort2, probs=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75) ) 

ad_cum <- ad_toci%>% 
  mutate(cohort_3lvl=case_when(
    grepl("control", akra_cohort)~"Control",
    .default=akra_cohort
  )) %>% 
  filter(!grepl("control", akra_cohort)) %>% 
  arrange(record_id, day_rel_car) %>%
  transmute(cohort_3lvl, record_id, day_rel_car, numdose=as.numeric(numdose))  %>%
  group_by(record_id) %>% 
  mutate(cumdose=cumsum(numdose)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  group_by(cohort_3lvl, day_rel_car) %>% reframe(med_dose=mean(cumdose),
                                              low_conf=quantile(cumdose, probs=c(0.25)[1]),
                                              high_conf=quantile(cumdose, probs=c(0.75)[1])
                                              ) %>% ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=day_rel_car, y=med_dose, color=cohort_3lvl, fill=cohort_3lvl)) + 
  #geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = low_conf, ymax = high_conf), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() 
  
ad_cum

ad1 <- ad_toci %>%
```

## Figure S12 PSM efficacy/survival analyses
```{r}
binary_outcomes <- c(
  'CR by 1 Year'
)

surv_outcomes <- tribble(
  ~outcome, ~time,       ~event,
  "PFS",    "tt_pfs_m",  "ev_pfs",
  "OS",     "tt_os_m",   "ev_os"
)

inc_outcomes <- tribble(
  ~outcome, ~time,       ~status, ~failcode,
  "Relapse",    "tt_pfs_m",  "ev_rel", 1)


cohort_var <- 'cohort_2lvl'
cohort_levels <- levels(factor(common_clean[[cohort_var]]))


binary_tbl <-
  map_dfr(binary_outcomes, function(outcome) {
    tibble(
      outcome = outcome,
      outcome_type = "Binary",
      psmcontrol_summary = fmt_binary(ccpsm, outcome, cohort_levels[1], cohort_var),
      
      psmtx_summary = fmt_binary(ccpsm, outcome, cohort_levels[2], cohort_var),
      
      effect = fmt_or(ccpsm, outcome, cohort_var),
      pval = fmt_or_pval(ccpsm, outcome, cohort_var)
      
    )
  })

surv_tbl <-
  pmap_dfr(surv_outcomes, function(outcome, time, event) {
    tibble(
      outcome = outcome,
      outcome_type = "Time-to-event",
      psmcontrol_summary = fmt_median_surv(ccpsm, time, event, cohort_levels[1], cohort_var),
      
      psmtx_summary = fmt_median_surv(ccpsm, time, event, cohort_levels[2], cohort_var),
      
      effect = fmt_hr(ccpsm, time, event, cohort_var),
      pval = fmt_hr_pval(ccpsm, time, event, cohort_var)
    )
  })

inc_tbl <-
  pmap_dfr(inc_outcomes, function(outcome, time, status, failcode) {
    tibble(
      outcome = outcome,
      outcome_type = "Cumulative Incidence at 12 months",
      psmcontrol_summary = calc_cif_at_time(data = ccpsm,time=time,status=status,failcode=failcode,cohort_level=cohort_levels[1],cohort_var=cohort_var),
      
      psmtx_summary = calc_cif_at_time(data = ccpsm,time=time,status=status,failcode=failcode,cohort_level=cohort_levels[2],cohort_var=cohort_var),
      
      effect = fmt_cihr(data=ccpsm, time=time, event=status, cohort_var=cohort_var, etype=as.character(failcode)),
      pval = fmt_cihr_pval(data=ccpsm, time=time, event=status, cohort_var=cohort_var, etype=as.character(failcode))
    )
  })

library(gt)

final_outcome_tbl <-
  bind_rows(binary_tbl, surv_tbl, inc_tbl) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "outcome_type") |>
  cols_label(
    outcome = md("**Outcome**"),
    #cohort_2_summary = md(paste0("**", 'Cohort 2', "**")),
    psmcontrol_summary = md(paste0("**", cohort_levels[1], "**")),
    psmtx_summary = md(paste0("**", cohort_levels[2], "**")),
    effect = md("**OR/HR (95% CI)**"),
    pval = md("**p value**")
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(psmtx_summary, psmcontrol_summary, effect)
  )
final_outcome_tbl

final_outcome_tbl %>%
  gtsave(here(figures_dir, "figs12.docx"))
```

# Sensitivity Analyses for PFS Association

## Sensitivity Analyses for Variance correction
```{r}
df <- m1 %>%
  mutate(
    trt = case_when(
      akra_cohort %in% c("cohort1", "cohort2") ~ 1,
      akra_cohort %in% c("cohort1 control", "cohort2 control") ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    match_groups = case_when(
      akra_cohort %in% c("cohort1", "cohort1 control") ~ "cohort1",
      akra_cohort %in% c("cohort2", "cohort2 control") ~ "cohort2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    match_groups = factor(match_groups, levels = c("cohort1", "cohort2")),
  )

cat('\n\nPrimary analysis.\n')
summary(coxph(
  Surv(tt_pfs_m, ev_pfs) ~ trt + strata(subclass),
  data = df
))

cat('\n\nSensitivity analysis with robust variance estimation\n ')
summary(coxph(
  Surv(tt_pfs_m, ev_pfs) ~ trt + strata(subclass) + cluster(subclass),
  data = df
))

cat('\n\nThere is no evidence that treatment/prophylaxis effect differs between cohort 1 and cohort 2\n ')
summary(coxph(
  Surv(tt_pfs_m, ev_pfs) ~ trt + trt:c2 + strata(subclass),
  data = df %>%  mutate(c2 = as.integer(match_groups == "cohort2"))
))

```

## Sensitivity Analyses for Variation in Matching

```{r}
# Matching with active CNS disease at infusion also considered
dfw <- df_nomissing %>% drop_na(active_cns) 
set.seed(1)
match_obj <- matchit(cohort_2lvl ~ age + kps_2lvl + costim + dx_heme + ds_res_infusion + bin_preld_ldh + active_cns, 
                     data = dfw,
                     method = "optimal",
                     distance = "logit", 
                     ratio=1
)
love.plot(match_obj, abs = T, thresholds = 0.1)

# SMD for distance = 0.15 (worse compared to SMD for distance without active CNS disease matching)
(love.plot(match_obj, abs = T, thresholds = 0.1)@data %>% filter(Sample=="Adjusted") %>% filter(var=="distance"))$stat

matched_data <- match.data(match_obj)
summary(coxph(Surv(tt_pfs_m, ev_pfs) ~ cohort_2lvl + strata(subclass),
              data = matched_data))
```

```{r}
dfw <- df_nomissing %>% drop_na(active_cns, d0_crp) 
set.seed(1)
match_obj <- matchit(cohort_2lvl ~ age + kps_2lvl + costim + dx_heme + ds_res_infusion + bin_preld_ldh + active_cns + log(d0_crp), 
                     data = dfw,
                     method = "optimal",
                     distance = "logit", 
                     ratio=1
)
love.plot(match_obj, abs = T, thresholds = 0.1)
matched_data <- match.data(match_obj)
summary(coxph(Surv(tt_pfs_m, ev_pfs) ~ cohort_2lvl + strata(subclass),
              data = matched_data))
```

# Anakinra Prophylaxis and Systemic Inflammation

## Figure S13 - Modeling interaction between Anakinra Prophylaxis and Baseline CRP.
```{r}
library(splines)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    crp_group = factor(
      bin_d0_crp,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("WNL", "Elevated")
    ),
    trt_wnl = trt * as.integer(bin_d0_crp == 0),
    trt_elevated = trt * as.integer(bin_d0_crp == 1)
  ) %>%
  mutate(logcrp=log(d0_crp)) %>%
  mutate(
    trt_c1_wnl = as.integer(trt == 1 & match_groups == "cohort1" & crp_group == "WNL"),
    trt_c2_wnl = as.integer(trt == 1 & match_groups == "cohort2" & crp_group == "WNL"),
    trt_c1_elev = as.integer(trt == 1 & match_groups == "cohort1" & crp_group == "Elevated"),
    trt_c2_elev = as.integer(trt == 1 & match_groups == "cohort2" & crp_group == "Elevated")
  ) 

fit_spline_linear <- coxph(
  Surv(tt_pfs_m, ev_pfs) ~ trt * logcrp,
  data = df,
  cluster = subclass
)

fit_spline <- coxph(
  Surv(tt_pfs_m, ev_pfs) ~ trt * ns(logcrp, df = 2),
  data = df,
  cluster = subclass
)

cat("\nA model fit where CRP is modeled non-linearly fits the data better than when CRP is modeled linearly.\n")
lmtest::lrtest(fit_spline, fit_spline_linear)

b <- coef(fit_spline)
V <- vcov(fit_spline)

int_terms <- grep("trt:ns\\(logcrp, df = 2\\)|ns\\(logcrp, df = 2\\).*:trt",
                  names(b),
                  value = TRUE)

L <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(int_terms),
  ncol = length(b),
  dimnames = list(int_terms, names(b))
)

for (i in seq_along(int_terms)) {
  L[i, int_terms[i]] <- 1
}

W <- as.numeric(t(L %*% b) %*% solve(L %*% V %*% t(L)) %*% (L %*% b))
p_interaction <- pchisq(W, df = nrow(L), lower.tail = FALSE)

data.frame(
  test = "Joint nonlinear treatment-by-logCRP interaction",
  chi_square = W,
  df = nrow(L),
  p = p_interaction
)

```

### Sensitivity analysis - Anakinra prophylaxis is associated with improved PFS with higher systemic inflammation even with an alternative matching strategy

We will see whether our treatment-by-CRP interaction findings hold when matching on additional variables (active cns disease, Day 0 CRP) and using an IPTW match design.

```{r}
dfw <- df_nomissing %>% drop_na(active_cns, bin_d0_crp)
set.seed(1)
w <- weightit(cohort_2lvl ~ age + kps_2lvl +  costim + dx_heme + ds_res_infusion + bin_preld_ldh + active_cns + bin_d0_crp, 
              data = dfw, method = 'glm',  estimand = "ATT")

dfw$iptw <- w$weights

dfw1 <- dfw %>%
  mutate(
    trt = case_when(
      akra_cohort %in% c("cohort 1", "cohort 2") ~ 1,
      akra_cohort %in% c("no anakinra") ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    match_groups = case_when(
      akra_cohort %in% c("cohort1", "cohort1 control") ~ "cohort1",
      akra_cohort %in% c("cohort2", "cohort2 control") ~ "cohort2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    match_groups = factor(match_groups, levels = c("cohort1", "cohort2")),
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    crp_group = factor(
      bin_d0_crp,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("WNL", "Elevated")
    ),
    trt_wnl = trt * as.integer(bin_d0_crp == 0),
    trt_elevated = trt * as.integer(bin_d0_crp == 1)
  ) %>%
  mutate(logcrp=log(d0_crp)) %>%
  mutate(
    trt_c1_wnl = as.integer(trt == 1 & match_groups == "cohort1" & crp_group == "WNL"),
    trt_c2_wnl = as.integer(trt == 1 & match_groups == "cohort2" & crp_group == "WNL"),
    trt_c1_elev = as.integer(trt == 1 & match_groups == "cohort1" & crp_group == "Elevated"),
    trt_c2_elev = as.integer(trt == 1 & match_groups == "cohort2" & crp_group == "Elevated")
  ) 

library(survminer)

fit_spline_linear <- coxph(
  Surv(tt_pfs_m, ev_pfs) ~ trt * logcrp,
  data = dfw1,
  weights = iptw,
  robust = TRUE
)

fit_spline <- coxph(
  Surv(tt_pfs_m, ev_pfs) ~ trt * ns(logcrp, df=2),
  data = dfw1,
  weights = iptw,
  robust = TRUE
)

cat("\nA model fit where CRP is modeled non-linearly again fits the data better than when CRP is modeled linearly.\n")
lmtest::lrtest(fit_spline, fit_spline_linear)

b <- coef(fit_spline)
V <- vcov(fit_spline)

int_terms <- grep("trt:ns\\(logcrp, df = 2\\)|ns\\(logcrp, df = 2\\).*:trt",
                  names(b),
                  value = TRUE)

L <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(int_terms),
  ncol = length(b),
  dimnames = list(int_terms, names(b))
)

for (i in seq_along(int_terms)) {
  L[i, int_terms[i]] <- 1
}

W <- as.numeric(t(L %*% b) %*% solve(L %*% V %*% t(L)) %*% (L %*% b))
p_interaction <- pchisq(W, df = nrow(L), lower.tail = FALSE)

cat("\nWhen modeled non-linearly (2nd order spline), baseline CRP again has a significant interaction with anakinra prophylaxis in its effect on PFS.\n")
data.frame(
  test = "Joint nonlinear treatment-by-logCRP interaction",
  chi_square = W,
  df = nrow(L),
  p = p_interaction
)

```

# Anakinra Prophylaxis and ALC trajectories

```{r}
## preparing laboratory and cytokine data for downstream analysis. 
akra_csum_dose <- akra_doses %>%
  arrange(record_id, day_rel_car) %>%
  mutate(daily_dose=as.numeric(daily_dose)) %>%
  group_by(record_id) %>%
  mutate(cdose = cumsum(daily_dose)) %>%
  ungroup() 

df_csum <- data.frame(record_id=rep(m1$record_id, each=39), day_rel_car=rep(seq(from=-3, to=35, by=1), times=length(m1$record_id))) %>%
  arrange(record_id, day_rel_car) %>% 
  left_join(m1 %>% select(record_id, akra_cohort))  %>%
  left_join(akra_csum_dose) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(cdose=ifelse(day_rel_car==-3, 0, cdose)) %>%
  mutate(daily_dose=ifelse(is.na(daily_dose), 0, daily_dose)) %>%
  arrange(record_id, day_rel_car) %>%
  fill(cdose, .direction = "down") %>%
  filter(day_rel_car <= 35) %>% distinct()

bin_visit <- function(day) {
  case_when(
    day <= 0             ~ "Baseline",
    day >= 1  & day <= 7 ~ "W1",
    day >= 8  & day <= 14 ~ "W2",
    day >= 15 & day <= 21 ~ "W3",
    day >= 21 & day <= 28 ~ "W4",
    TRUE                 ~ NA_character_
  )
}

dat_pre <- df %>%
  transmute(
    record_id = factor(record_id),
    subclass = factor(subclass),
    trt_f = factor(
      trt,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("control", "anakinra")
    ),
    akra_cohort_f = factor(
      akra_cohort,
      levels = c(
        "cohort1 control",
        "cohort1",
        "cohort2 control",
        "cohort2"
      )
    ),
    akra_cohort_3lvl_f = factor(
      case_when(
        grepl('control', akra_cohort)~"control",
        akra_cohort=="cohort1"~"cohort1",
        akra_cohort=="cohort2"~"cohort2",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = c("control", "cohort1", "cohort2")
    ),
    match_groups_f=factor(match_groups, levels=c("cohort1", "cohort2")),
    sex_f = factor(sex),
    age_c = as.numeric(scale(age, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)),
    costim_f=factor(costim)
  ) 

### OLINK
# These cytokines did not pass QC for our analysis, the majority of values were under the limit of detection. 
mostly_under_lod <- c("il1_a", "adgrg1", "fgf2", "nos3", "il2", "vegfc", "il33", "il5", "arg1", "ptn", "cxcl12", "il4", "il13")

dat_olink <- match_olink %>% 
  mutate(
    visit_f = factor(bin_visit(day_rel_car),
               levels = c("Baseline", "W1", "W2", "W3", "W4"))
  ) %>%
  select(!matches(mostly_under_lod)) %>%
  mutate(across(il8:csf_1, ~as.numeric(.))) %>% drop_na() %>%
  left_join(dat_pre, by="record_id") %>%
  drop_na(trt_f) %>%
  left_join(df_nomissing %>% select(record_id, tt_crs_d, ev_crs)) %>%
  mutate(crs=factor(case_when(
    is.na(ev_crs)~NA,
    ev_crs==1 & day_rel_car>=tt_crs_d~1,
    .default=0
  )
  )) %>%
  mutate(
     crs_f = factor(
      crs,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("no_prior_crs", "prior_crs")
    ),
  day_rel_car=as.integer(day_rel_car)
  ) %>%
    select(!c(ev_crs, tt_crs_d, crs)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(record_id, day_rel_car, akra_cohort_f, akra_cohort_3lvl_f, trt_f, match_groups_f, subclass, crs_f, age_c, sex_f, costim_f, visit_f), names_to = "lab", values_to = "npx" ) %>%
  mutate(lab = factor(lab)) 


### LABS
labs_interest <- c("crp", "anc", "alc", 'plt')

dat_labs_pre <- infl_lab_trend %>% 
  mutate(
    visit_f = factor(bin_visit(day_rel_car),
               levels = c("Baseline", "W1", "W2", "W3", "W4"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(dat_pre, by="record_id") %>%
  drop_na(trt_f) %>% 
  left_join(df_nomissing %>% select(record_id, tt_crs_d, ev_crs)) %>%
  mutate(crs=factor(case_when(
    is.na(ev_crs)~NA,
    ev_crs==1 & day_rel_car>=tt_crs_d~1,
    .default=0
  )
  )) %>%
  mutate(
     crs_f = factor(
      crs,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("no_prior_crs", "prior_crs")
    ),
  day_rel_car=as.integer(day_rel_car)
  ) %>%
   select(!c(ev_crs, tt_crs_d, crs)) %>% 
   filter(lab %in% c(labs_interest, "wbc")) %>%
   group_by(record_id, lab, day_rel_car) %>% slice(which.max(result_value/uln)) %>% ungroup() 


fixzero_alc <- dat_labs_pre %>% filter(lab =="wbc") %>% mutate(wbc=result_value) %>%
  left_join(
    dat_labs_pre %>% filter(lab =="alc") %>% select(record_id, alc=result_value, day_rel_car)
  ) %>% filter(is.na(alc)&wbc <= 0.5) %>%
  mutate(lab="alc", result_value=0, uln=0.3) %>% select(!c(wbc, alc))

fixzero_anc <- dat_labs_pre %>% filter(lab =="wbc") %>% mutate(wbc=result_value) %>%

    dat_labs_pre %>% filter(lab =="anc") %>% select(record_id, anc=result_value, day_rel_car)
  ) %>% filter(is.na(anc)&wbc <= 0.5) %>%
  mutate(lab="anc", result_value=0, uln=0.3) %>% select(!c(wbc, anc))

dat_labs <- dat_labs_pre %>% filter(lab!="wbc") %>%  
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(npx=(log2(result_value+1e-3)/uln)) %>%
  group_by(lab) %>% mutate(npx=scale(npx)) %>% ungroup()

# LUMINEX
c1_lumin1a <- c1_luminex %>% filter(day_rel_car==0) %>%
  filter(source!="csf") %>% select(!c(timepoint, source, day_rel_car)) %>% 
  rename(tnf_a=tn_fa, ifn_g=if_ng) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(record_id), names_to="cytokine", values_to = "blval")

c1_lumin2 <- c1_luminex %>% 
  filter(source!="csf") %>% select(!c(timepoint, source)) %>% 
  rename(tnf_a=tn_fa, ifn_g=if_ng) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(record_id, day_rel_car), names_to="cytokine", values_to = "value") %>% 
  left_join(c1_lumin1a %>% select(record_id, cytokine, blval)) %>% drop_na(blval) %>% 
  group_by(record_id, cytokine) %>% mutate(norm_value=log2(value/blval)) %>% ungroup() 

c2_lumin1a <- c2_luminex %>% filter(day_rel_car==0) %>%
  select(record_id, day_rel_car, cytokine, blval=value) 

c2_lumin2 <- c2_luminex %>% 
  left_join(c2_lumin1a %>% select(record_id, cytokine, blval)) %>% 
  drop_na(blval) %>% select(!source) %>% 
  group_by(record_id, cytokine) %>% mutate(norm_value=log2(value/blval)) %>% ungroup()  

luminex <- bind_rows(c1_lumin2 %>% mutate(cohort="cohort1"), c2_lumin2 %>% mutate(cohort="cohort2"))
luminexpanels <- unique(luminex$cytokine)

luminex_interest <- luminexpanels


dat_lumin <- luminex %>% 
  mutate(
    visit_f = factor(bin_visit(day_rel_car),
               levels = c("Baseline", "W1", "W2", "W3", "W4"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(dat_pre, by="record_id") %>%
  drop_na(trt_f) %>% 
  left_join(df_nomissing %>% select(record_id, tt_crs_d, ev_crs)) %>%
  mutate(crs=factor(case_when(
    is.na(ev_crs)~NA,
    ev_crs==1 & day_rel_car>=tt_crs_d~1,
    .default=0
  )
  )) %>%
  mutate(
     crs_f = factor(
      crs,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("no_prior_crs", "prior_crs")
    ),
  day_rel_car=as.integer(day_rel_car)
  ) %>%
    select(!c(ev_crs, tt_crs_d, crs)) %>% 
  rename(lab=cytokine, npx=norm_value)

```

## Linear mixed effects modeling to estimate treatment effect on laboratory measures post-infusion compared to baseline.

Patient IDs included as random effects to account for repeated measures per patient. P-values and confidence intervals were derived using cluster-robust variance estimation (clubSandwich package) to account for within-match pair correlation. 

### Figure S8 - bottom (paired boxplots of ALC changes)

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5, dpi=150}
df_time=3
bld = 0
evt=c(3,5,7,10,14,28)

cluster_var <- "subclass"
covariates <- c("age_c", "sex_f", "costim_f", 'crs_f')
model_vars <- c("npx", "trt_f", "day_rel_car", "record_id", cluster_var, covariates)
fml <- as.formula(paste("npx ~", paste(
    c(paste0("trt_f * splines::ns(day_rel_car, df = ", df_time, ")"), covariates  ,"(1 | record_id)"),
    collapse = " + ")))
 
dat1 <- dat_labs %>%
    filter(day_rel_car >= -2 & day_rel_car <= 28) %>%  
    filter(complete.cases(across(all_of(model_vars)))) %>%
    droplevels() 
labs <- sort(unique(dat1$lab))

# evaluate CRP missigness and assessment patterns in both treatment and control cohorts
dat1 %>% group_by(lab, visit_f, record_id, trt_f) %>% reframe(labs_per_pt=n()) %>% ungroup()  %>%
  filter(lab=='crp') %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=visit_f, y=labs_per_pt)) +
  ylab("CRP Measures Per Patient") + 
  facet_wrap(trt_f~.) + 
  geom_boxplot() + geom_jitter()

# Prepare ALC data
a <- dat1 %>% 
  filter(lab=='alc') %>% 
  filter(visit_f=="Baseline") %>%
  group_by(record_id) %>% 
  slice(which.max(day_rel_car)) %>% 
  ungroup()  %>%
  bind_rows(
    dat1 %>% 
  filter(lab=='alc') %>% 
  filter(visit_f!="Baseline") %>%
  group_by(record_id, visit_f) %>% 
  slice(which.max(npx)) %>% 
  ungroup()  
  ) %>% 
  filter(visit_f %in% c("Baseline", "W1", "W2", "W4")) %>% 
  transmute(record_id, trt_f, visit_f, result_value=result_value, subclass) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from="visit_f", values_from = "result_value", values_fill = NA) %>%
  mutate(diff=log2((W2 + 0.01)/(Baseline+0.01))) %>%
  select(!c(Baseline, W1, W2, W4, record_id)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = trt_f, values_from = diff, values_fill = NA) %>%
  drop_na()

print("t test for comparing Week 2 peak - Day 0 ALC fold change between treatment and matched control cohorts")
t.test(a$control, a$anakinra, paired = T)
pairdbox_alc <- ggpaired(data=a, cond1="control", cond2="anakinra") + stat_compare_means(paired = T)

print(pairdbox_alc)
ggsave(here(figures_dir, 'figs8a.pdf'), width = 8, height = 5)
```

# Linear Mixed Effects Modeling - Effect Size estimation. Methods validation

Code to derive p-values and confidence estimates from linear mixed model objects uses a lot of wrapper and helper functions. To make the analysis more interpretable and facilitate validation/peer-review. I will validate and reproduce key findings using a more direct alternative script.

### Evaluate treatment effect on ALC change at day 7 compared to day 0 using results above.

```{r}

fig_res <- results_time_spline_labs %>% 
  filter(contrast_class=="did_vs_baseline" & day_rel_car==7) %>%
  filter(lab=='alc')

cat(paste0('\nThe estimated log2 fold change over cohort 1 at Day 7 is ', fig_res$estimate_log2, " and the p-value is ", fig_res$p, '\n'))

```

And now we will try to replicate the finding with a simpler script. First to get the estimated effect size with p-value and confidence estimated without clubSandwich.

```{r, echo=TRUE}
df_time=3
bld = 0
evt=c(3,5,7,10,14,28)

cluster_var <- "subclass"
covariates <- c("age_c", "sex_f", "costim_f", 'crs_f')
model_vars <- c("npx", "trt_f", "day_rel_car", "record_id", cluster_var, covariates)
fml <- as.formula(paste("npx ~", paste(
    c(paste0("trt_f * splines::ns(day_rel_car, df = ", df_time, ")"), covariates  ,"(1 | record_id)"),
    collapse = " + ")))
 
dat_lab <- dat_labs %>%
    filter(day_rel_car >= -2 & day_rel_car <= 28) %>%  
    filter(complete.cases(across(all_of(model_vars)))) %>%
    droplevels() %>% filter(lab=='alc')

fit <-  lme4::lmer(
    fml,
    data = dat_lab,
    REML = FALSE
  )

library(lme4)
b <- fixef(fit)

knots_info <- with(dat_lab, splines::ns(day_rel_car, df = 3))
B <- splines::ns(c(0, 7), df = 3,
                 knots = attr(knots_info, "knots"),
                 Boundary.knots = attr(knots_info, "Boundary.knots"))

bs0 <- B[1, ]  
bs7 <- B[2, ]  

idx_int <- grep("^trt_fanakinra:splines", names(b))
b_int <- b[idx_int]

idx_sp <- grep("^splines::ns", names(b))
b_sp <- b[idx_sp]

did <- sum((bs7 - bs0) * b_int)

V <- vcov(fit)

L_did <- numeric(length(b))
names(L_did) <- names(b)
L_did[idx_int] <- bs7 - bs0

se_did <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(L_did) %*% V %*% L_did))

cat("Difference-in-differences (day7 vs day0):\n")
cat(sprintf("  Estimate: %.4f, SE: %.4f, z: %.3f, p: %.4f\n",
            did, se_did, did / se_did, 2 * pnorm(-abs(did / se_did))))

```

And now will account for correlation within match pairs.

```{r, echo=TRUE}
library(clubSandwich)

V_cr2 <- clubSandwich::vcovCR(fit, cluster = dat_lab$subclass, type = "CR2")
se_did_robust  <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(L_did)  %*% V_cr2 %*% L_did))

result_did  <- clubSandwich::Wald_test(fit, constraints = matrix(L_did, nrow = 1),
                         vcov = V_cr2, test = "HTZ")
cat(paste0("P value after accounting for within match-pair correlation: ", result_did$p_val))
```

The two sets of values are very similar.
